name: cx-rules-only~p3
task: Do not take the box from the other room. At any moment you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it afterwards, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Absence(target_picked_up) is hard for the hard prohibition on taking the box. RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) is soft, matching 'try to have the door open then or open it afterwards'. Absence(key_lost) is soft, matching 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed'. No goal is required unconditionally, so the rule-only warning and empty FINAL_STATES are valid.
